summary: The technology director for Saint Jude the Apostle Catholic School urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, emphasizing the essential role of reliable broadband in modern education and the financial impact of reducing or eliminating E-Rate support. The comments urge protection of the E-Rate program to ensure continued connectivity for students and schools.

claims.argument: The program is essential for providing connectivity to students and schools.
claims.evidence_quote: As our nation seeks to prepare students for college, careers, and an increasingly technology-driven economy, now is not the time to undermine the very program and related infrastructure that makes those opportunities possible.
